plan_item: A58 — submit unresolved cell/tool gaps as explicit non-build requests with consequences; pending requests remain open

authoritative_state.note: Requests below are the named reasons the count cannot move without a decision or an approval. None of them is a build task; writing more code does not close any of them.

requests.title: Extend the D85 static analyzer to resolve two stdlib assignment forms
requests.ask: Teach `_surface_of_py` to resolve `hashlib.sha256` (hashlib.py:307 assigns via `globals()[__func_name] = __get_hash(...)`) and `os.environ.get` (os.py:769 `environ = _createenviron()`), or approve removing those calls from reachable paths in the registered estate sources.
requests.why_non_build: This is a decision about the admission analyzer's semantics in a payload owned by another lane (rig-determinism-85 / d85.py), being edited concurrently. Declaring the externals again is provably a no-op — the registrar re-emits a byte-identical record.
blocked: build_standard_chain_v1 and estate_automation_ledger_v1 cannot be scored (EXTERNAL_CALL_UNRESOLVED before any inventory hash exists)
therefore no `.classification.json` can be written for them without fabricating an inventory binding
therefore every Gate-D mint_command that recomputes score_realized fails before recording an approval
therefore the four instruction surfaces (A14-A22) stay UNWIRED and no certified durable-build run can mint a certificate
affected_cells: every P-step cell whose certificate depends on a scoreable process
affected_plan_items: all of Section V statistical qualification
requests.consequence_if_not_granted: 0/588 cells stay qualified; the standard is enforceable in code but cannot be exercised end to end on this estate.

requests.title: Authorize the live `rig_build` storage target (B11/B12)
requests.ask: Name the Supabase project/database that owns `rig_build`, grant a scoped server-side credential, and approve applying the frozen DDL (ddl_sha256 recorded in the migrate plan) plus the role grants.
requests.why_non_build: Schema application, credential issuance, and role grants on shared infrastructure are exactly the class of change that requires typed approval — no amount of local code substitutes for the target.
affected_cells: every cell whose run record lives in rig_build (I1/Q1/R/S/Q2/P/I2 for all 588)
requests.consequence_if_not_granted: The backend stays provable only against a throwaway cluster; durable run state, approval references, and qualification rows cannot exist, so no cell can ever be marked qualified.

requests.title: Decide the codex agent-asset format so `rig-stackwright` load can be verified
requests.ask: Confirm whether codex loads `~/.codex/agents/*.md` (659 entries there are mixed `.md` and `agency-*.toml`) or whether the canonical agent must ship as `.toml`. If `.toml`, approve a generated twin in `capabilities/agents/`.
requests.why_non_build: There is no `.toml` precedent in the canonical `capabilities/agents/` directory (all four assets are `.md`); inventing a second format without the runtime's answer is guesswork, and the harness does not attest which files it actually loads.
affected_cells: L1-D1-A1-I1 (onboarding/agent-shape cell) for the codex runtime
requests.consequence_if_not_granted: One of four runtimes keeps an unverifiable agent load; the standard's onboarding claim stays partial.

requests.title: Typed Gate-D approval for the four instruction surfaces
requests.ask: Approve the four staged rows (claude_code, hermes, omp, prime_agent) once NB-01 lands — mint and consume in the same interpreter context.
requests.why_non_build: Instruction surfaces are registered authority files. Nothing was written to them this session; dormancy was independently re-proved by marker grep (0 matches in all four targets).
affected_cells: every cell whose mandatory doctrine must load in a foreign session
requests.consequence_if_not_granted: Agents keep relying on copied skill files rather than an enforced load — the exact failure A55 names.

requests.title: Fix Memory OS write policy and search backend
requests.ask: Name the intake namespace that machine callers may write to, and repair the search backend (`ValidationError: knowledge_backend_failed`).
requests.why_non_build: Policy and backend health are outside any repo edit I can make; guessing namespace strings to probe the policy returned `knowledge_path_not_allowed` and `knowledge_write_requires_intake_namespace`, and probing further is noise, not progress.

requests.title: Provider credentials for LangSmith evaluation (and any paid provider)
requests.ask: Either issue credentials or record the pack as blocked-live with a named non-build consequence.
requests.why_non_build: A30 is explicit: missing credentials means blocked live verification, not silent substitution.

requests.title: A session-restart window to observe loaded/exercised/enforced per runtime
requests.ask: Restart one Claude, one Hermes, one codex, and one Prime session, then ask each to name the standard's gate vocabulary; record the four receipts.
requests.why_non_build: Load state is only observable in a session that starts after the install. No repo change can manufacture it, and this session predates the install.
